# function: partnercentral_relationship

Builds the ARN of an `partnercentral` `Relationship`:

```
arn:${Partition}:partnercentral:${Region}:${Account}:catalog/${Catalog}/program-management-account/${ProgramManagementAccountId}/relationship/${RelationshipId}
```

`${Partition}`, `${Region}` and `${Account}` come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
partnercentral_relationship(catalog string, program_management_account_id string, relationship_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `catalog` (String) Value for `${Catalog}` in the ARN template.
1. `program_management_account_id` (String) Value for `${ProgramManagementAccountId}` in the ARN template.
1. `relationship_id` (String) Value for `${RelationshipId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given.
